supported: status
setup (TTY wizard + non-interactive flags/JSON; privacy defaults OFF)
login/logout
doctor (structured diagnostics; --json; network opt-in; local --repair-journal with explicit replay-risk flag)
lockdown (immediate local containment); unlock and token revoke (typed admin actions; fresh browser passkey approval)
no-argument TUI launch and completion generation (bash/zsh/fish/powershell/elvish)
config get/set/edit/validate (typed keys, atomic save, no secret fields)
instance add/list/use/remove (validated control-plane URLs)
device enroll/list/show/rename/labels/rotate-key/revoke
exec (local IPC or authenticated remote MCP; exact argv; explicit remote idempotency)
process start/status/logs/stop (bounded daemon-owned sessions, exact argv)
session list/show/open/attach/claim/release/give/close/terminate (local IPC; authenticated remote creation)
profile scan/list/show/login/test/start/resume (credential-isolated daemon profile/session contract)
approval list/show/watch/approve/deny (typed decisions; fresh browser passkey for mutations; /approve inbox + batch set commitment; deny-all without passkey)
policy show/validate/explain/preset/rule mutation (typed admin actions; fresh browser passkey approval)
grants list/show/revoke/mint (bounded tool grants lift Ask only; mint is fresh-passkey admin; revoke/lockdown are local tightening)
transfer plan/send/list/status/cancel (authenticated control-plane MCP; destination replace only with overwrite_expected_sha256; no blind force; idempotency keys required for mutations)
mcp serve --stdio (authenticated configured issuer; bounded JSONL bridge)
service install/start/stop/restart/status/uninstall (user-level ownmeshd autostart only)
privileged broker install/status/uninstall (networkless native lifecycle: Linux systemd, macOS launchd, Windows SCM; native release receipts tracked separately)
update default/check/download/apply/status/channel (signed crash-safe self-update; network off by default)
workspace list/show/add/update/remove (device-local registry via ownmeshd IPC)

logs providers/query (authenticated local IPC; bounded, cursor-paged device log read across audit, journald, Docker/Podman, and process providers, plus Windows Event Log on Windows; no remote route and no remote log-body persistence)
notes: v1.2.22 stable surface contract. Completeness means every CLI surface admitted by this shipped registry has an implemented, fail-closed handler; it is not a claim that the aspirational specification, every optional packaging format, or every external platform receipt is complete. E5 provides bounded PTY/process-tree and replay behavior. E6 provides nine structured profile adapters plus CLI profile flows. E7 provides bounded unified-diff review execution. E9 provides authenticated resumable transfer and the public transfer CLI. Device metadata mutation, authenticated remote exec/session creation, approval watch, profile management, bounded MCP stdio, and typed security-admin actions are supported. Sensitive approval, policy, unlock, and token mutations require an operation-bound fresh passkey decision and execute exactly once. Workspace create/list/show on the Control Plane overlay pending_activation versus active so remote execution cannot outrun Agent generation; device-local registry changes are published incrementally via the authenticated workspace.registry refresh (ADR 0014) so activation no longer waits for a reconnect. The local CLI/TUI workspace surface remains the device-local registry. E8's networkless broker lifecycle is implemented on Linux, macOS, and Windows; Linux has a native root receipt, while macOS/Windows native release receipts and the full E8 public-route receipt remain open evidence. Live ChatGPT DCR/OAuth/passkey return has a manual compatibility receipt; reproducible automated E10 evidence remains open. SERVICE_VERSION 1.2.22. Doctor `--check-network` compares CLI and control-plane `/health` versions and now observes live Agent-route presence (daemon.agent_route; system.diagnose gains agent_route/agent_route_offline). Terminal operation failures reconcile their op-journal marker into a replayable failed receipt instead of stranding in_progress keys. Agent/transfer WebSocket connects are bounded with Happy Eyeballs-style IPv4 fallback (connect_timeout is a reconnect category), so a blackholed AAAA cannot park a reconnect forever. Linux disclosures: spawn resolution errors list the searched directories (service PATH plus user-local extras, never shell rc); EPERM spawns and doctor disclose RestrictNamespaces=yes and its operator drop-in; Linger=no warns that the ChatGPT route ends with the desktop session (lingering is never enabled automatically). Expired MCP Bearer tokens return HTTP 401 with `WWW-Authenticate`. Generic and review command execution binds the approved invocation entry, backing object, exact argv0, and classification; drift returns a typed re-authorization error, and prepared executable custody closes the verify-to-spawn path race. Doctor and system.diagnose expose durable journal health (transition records and op-journal pressure) and profile-discovery status; systemd --user unit hardening (effective directives including drop-ins) is disclosed by doctor. Service lifecycle state is verified rather than assumed: `service start`/`stop` cross the observable daemon IPC boundary and return OWNMESH_E_SERVICE when the transition cannot be confirmed, macOS `stop` boots the KeepAlive LaunchAgent out of the user domain, and uninstall reports every launchctl/systemctl failure while retaining the descriptor and install record until the manager confirms the service inactive — a probe that proves nothing is classified unknown, never as absence. `service install` reconciles the descriptor actually registered with the OS against a versioned digest in user-service.json (systemd unit body, macOS plist, and the Windows task's structural action/trigger/settings identity), independent of whether the service is currently loaded. The Windows Scheduled Task binds the validated install-time config/state/runtime directories through typed `ownmeshd run --config-dir/--state-dir/--runtime-dir` arguments shared by the XML import and the /TR fallback, so an autostarted daemon can no longer split one installation into two state trees. Local IPC endpoints are validated before bind: Unix pathnames are checked against the platform sockaddr_un capacity with a deterministic short owner-only fallback, and Windows pipes are scoped by a SHA-256 digest of the normalized runtime path so distinct profiles cannot share a pipe. Structured-pipe sessions publish EOF and a real exit code, and a forced cutoff seals the streams so no output can appear after completion is reported.
